Rolfsån crossing via old stone bridge context.
Winding paved roads through agricultural landscape with views toward Kungsbackafjorden.

seasonalOrServiceLimitations: Västtrafik line 732 service frequency, stop pattern and last departures should be checked for the actual travel date.
Tjolöholm parking is fee-based. Official page says 40 SEK/4h, 50 SEK/4h between 2 Jun and 27 Aug, then 10 SEK/hour after four hours.
Tjolöholm has paid motorhome quickstop spaces, but camping is prohibited elsewhere on the estate; do not model quickstop as hiker camping.
No ferry, public boat or rowboat transfer applies to K2.
commuteAccess.importRecommendation: Import Kungsbacka C as high-confidence start rail/bus access. Keep Lekarekulle and Åsa as fallback/context only.

camping.rule: Tents, wind shelters, tarps or roofed hammocks may be set up only at places designated by the reserve manager; overnight stay at such a place may not exceed two consecutive nights.
Official Tjolöholm access page says camping is prohibited across Tjolöholm, while paid quickstop motorhome spaces exist at the parking area.

protectedAreas.name: Tjolöholms naturreservat
rules: Do not damage living or dead trees, bushes or branches.
Do not damage, pick or collect mosses, lichens or fungi other than single specimens; edible mushroom picking is allowed.
Do not put up signs, posters, markings or inscriptions.
Motor vehicles only on roads and parking only at places designated by the reserve manager.
Tents, wind shelters, tarps or roofed hammocks only at places designated by the reserve manager; no more than two consecutive nights at such places.
Dogs may not be off leash.
No caravans, camping vans or motorhomes parked in the reserve 22:00-06:00.
Fires only at grill places designated by the reserve manager.
Cycling only on roads designated by the reserve manager.
Riding or horse traffic prohibited except estate exception.
Do not remove or damage stone walls, cairns or other cultural remains.
Do not launch or land aircraft.
protectedAreas.importGuidance: Import active reserve span/rules; public inauguration date does not delay legal effect.

lanes.summary: Confirmed K2 official identity/order, Kusten order 2, official 22 km, Grön/easy, no official time, description, GPX/API metadata, official 19-place list, Tjolöholm/Kungsbackafjorden source context and currentness risks.

Confirmed official GPX/API geo_json as navigation-grade, exact GPX/API match with 281 points and 22.140 km, K1 handoff 17.2 m, K3 handoff 0.3 m, missing line.geometry, no exact OSM K2 relation and no live Naturkartan K2 linework.

Classified Kungsbacka endpoint services, Nattmössan, Kvarndammet shelter/fireplace, Tjolöholm lodging/Storstugan/parking/toilets and side/pending/suppress records including Fjärås services, Silverlyckans, Tjolöholm water/beach/visitor centre and dense urban services.

Confirmed strong Kungsbacka C rail/bus access, official Torpa Smedja/Västtrafik 732 plus 3.5 km walk for Tjolöholm, fee-based Tjolöholm parking, fallback Lekarekulle/Åsa and no ferry/boat/demand-responsive access.
Found no active K2 closure/reroute, one useful 2026-03-28 partial reverse field report and recent Tjolöholm local-loop reports with good conditions but rocky/steep/slippery endpoint terrain caveats.

Found Tjolöholm reserve span, Kungsbackafjorden NR/Natura final-context span, no active closure, dynamic fire policy, road/rail/water/coastal hazards, forestry-currentness caveats and unresolved bird-protection/water questions.

researchIterations.decision: Initial six lanes were strong, but Kvarndammet shelter/fireplace coordinate, Tjolöholm endpoint service coordinates and Kungsbackafjorden bird-protection overlap needed targeted follow-up before synthesis.

lanes.summary: Could not find an exact Kvarndammet shelter/fireplace coordinate. Confirmed best approximate route-shore proxy 57.412917,12.112529 and OSM lake center 57.4144363,12.1131465. Confirmed Tjolöholm parking, toilet, water, Storstugan and Manegen coordinates.
Independently recommended route-aligned Kvarndammet anchor 57.413946,12.113803 at route km 20.440, confirmed parking about 62-64 m from K2 end and toilet cluster about 260-262 m from K2 end.

Confirmed Tjolöholm reserve rules are legally in force from 2025-12-20. Found no vector proof that Kungsbackafjorden seven bird-protection subareas overlap K2; recommended nearby seasonal warning rather than closure.

researchIterations.decision: Proceed to synthesis with explicit caveats: Kvarndammet shelter/fireplace coordinate approximate, Tjolöholm water pending, Kungsbackafjorden seasonal bird-protection warning only.
